title: The No-Nonsense Guide to How to Sell Ebooks from Kenya

excerpt: Selling digital products from Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or Zimbabwe is fully operational with sovereign commerce infrastructure that has no geographic restrictions.

content.text: In Kenya, selling ebooks online can be challenging due to restrictions on platforms like Stripe and PayPal. However, with the right infrastructure, you can overcome these limitations and reach a global audience. This guide will walk you through how to set up a sovereign digital commerce stack, enabling you to sell ebooks and other digital products directly to international buyers.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to successfully selling ebooks from Kenya lies in leveraging a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure. This approach allows you to own your stack, eliminating dependence on third-party platforms that may restrict your access. By utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, you can create a fully operational online store that automatically handles payments and product delivery.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, ensure you have a clear understanding of your product offerings, target audience, and the cryptocurrencies you wish to accept. It's also crucial to select the right networks for low fees, such as BSC, Solana, or TRON, to minimize transaction costs. Having a basic understanding of how blockchain-based payments work will also be beneficial in setting up your store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments into your store. This involves creating an account, obtaining an API key, and configuring the payment gateway to work with your chosen cryptocurrencies. For delivery, you can use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store and distribute your digital products. Ensure that your store is properly configured to automatically deliver products upon successful payment verification.
Sovereign digital commerce infrastructure empowers creators to own their stack and reach a global audience.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. Start by testing your payment pipeline with a small transaction to ensure everything is working as expected. Promote your store through various channels to attract your first customers. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments gateway will automatically verify the payment and trigger the delivery of your digital product.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows, it's essential to scale your infrastructure to meet increasing demand. This may involve upgrading your hosting plan, optimizing your backend logic, or expanding your product offerings.
